$comment: Copy to probe.config.json. pi-probe reads it from next to the extension; set PI_PROBE_CONFIG to point elsewhere. This file is gitignored -- yours is yours, and an allowlist is a personal decision, not a shared one.
$comment_extraEnv: Environment variable NAMES to pass through. Secret-shaped names are refused even if listed here, so this is for things like a proxy or a colour setting, never a token. See the README for why.
